description: Defines the Audience class representing the 'aud' field in JWTs, including methods for parsing JSON values into Audience objects, and utility methods like getSinglePrinciple.

classes.name: Audience
classes.description: Represents the 'aud' claim in JWT tokens, providing methods to construct from JSON, retrieve principles, and compare instances.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an Audience instance from a JSON value representing the 'aud' claim.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty Audience instance with no principles.

methods.name: getSinglePrinciple
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the single principle if only one exists, otherwise empty.

methods.name: getPrinciples
methods.description: Returns the list of principles in the Audience.
